_comment: Manual overrides for SKU spec fields that Apple does not surface in any parseable form on the family or per-config pages. Each rule applies a small patch to every SKU row that matches the where-clause. Sourced from Apple's marketing pages (apple.com/<product>/) where the GB values are stated in human-readable text.

rules.name: MacBook Neo: A18 Pro chip across all variants
MacBook Neo 256GB SSD ships with 8GB memory
MacBook Neo 512GB SSD ships with 16GB memory
